name: codeknight
description: Lets Claude check its staged changes, or a diff, with CodeKnight before committing. Rule-based checks run on your machine with no account. AI review is optional and uses your CodeKnight server.

api_token.title: CodeKnight API token (optional)
api_token.description: Only for AI review: the client token that `codeknight login` issues. Leave empty to run only the local rule-based checks.

server_url.title: CodeKnight server URL (optional)
server_url.description: Only for AI review: your CodeKnight server (https:// only). Leave empty to run only the local rule-based checks.
